_doc: Player-mode archetypes. Each is a role plus a specialty: 'up' raises the per-stat combine ceiling, 'down' lowers it (stat id -> points). See scripts/season/archetypes.gd.

archetypes.name: Breacher
archetypes.blurb: Kicks the door in. Wins the first contact and the push onto the hill.

archetypes.name: Bruiser
archetypes.blurb: Big, hard to kill and hard to move.

archetypes.name: Rusher
archetypes.blurb: Fast and loud up close, rattled when the plan falls apart.

archetypes.name: Gunslinger
archetypes.blurb: Quick on the draw, with the fastest reload on the roster.

archetypes.name: Wall
archetypes.blurb: Plants on the point and refuses to leave.

archetypes.name: Sniper
archetypes.blurb: Long sightlines and a steady hand.

archetypes.name: Shotcaller
archetypes.blurb: Reads the whole map and keeps the squad on one page.

archetypes.name: Marksman
archetypes.blurb: Dependable mid-range gunfighter with tight grouping.

archetypes.name: Anchor
archetypes.blurb: Holds the hill and calms the room.

archetypes.name: Overwatch
archetypes.blurb: Sees everything from a distance and rarely moves.

archetypes.name: Runner
archetypes.blurb: Never tires and is always already there.

archetypes.name: Skirmisher
archetypes.blurb: Dances in and out of fights, firing as he moves.

archetypes.name: Objective Hunter
archetypes.blurb: Lives for the point, and knows when to contest it.

archetypes.name: Scout
archetypes.blurb: The first to see and the first to relay.

archetypes.name: Utility
archetypes.blurb: Good at everything a team needs and elite at nothing.
